name: grudge-dev-tool

roles.label: Installed application
roles.performance: Read mostly; SSD improves cold start.

roles.label: Live data / database indexes
roles.performance: SSD preferred for random reads and writes.

roles.label: Temporary work and caches
roles.performance: SSD preferred; separate from retained data.

roles.label: Media / assets / retained datasets
roles.performance: HDD suitable for sequential reads and writes; grows with imports.

roles.label: Optional active AI models
roles.performance: SSD preferred for model loading. Actual model manifest size takes precedence.

roles.label: Backup destination
roles.performance: Separate physical drive preferred; capacity depends on retained data.

sizeBasis: Payload bytes are measured after a future build. Required data/scratch values are operational allowances; recommendations are growth scenarios, not preallocated storage or measured requirements.
usage: While actively used; closing may leave tray/owned service
aiModels: Ollama grudge-dev/llama3.2; optional Hunyuan3D/TRELLIS provider weights; cloud Workers AI has no PC weights
publication: Only installer/release artifacts; no personal paths, databases, keys, media or private source.
